shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json; printf '\\n--- ajv package ---\\n'; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json'))\" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"validateInput|Invalid inputSchema|additionalProperties|ToolRegistry\" src/orchestration/tools src | head -120 && sed -n '1,220p' src/shared/logger.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix tool input schema validation build" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -1 --format='%H %s' && git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}"
